en.hubeali: Ahmad Bin Muhammad, raising it, said,
‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Be cautious of having dealings with the people with deformities, for they are the most unjust ones’.
en.sarwar: 5. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad

from ibn Faddal from Zarif ibn Nasih who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘You must not form contracts with anyone other than those who are established in goodness.”
